rejection_criterion.rule: Each of the five matched-noise direct-rival-minus-candidate Brier gains must be strictly positive, and the matched-minus-independent quadratic-pair gain must be strictly positive. Any nonpositive value contradicts this fixed-panel joint directional prediction.
rejection_criterion.uncertainty: Show all eight founder gains, nominal paired founder-block95% intervals and leave-one-founder-out sensitivity. Do not treat256 futures as256 independent founders. A directionally positive pilot with an interval spanning zero leaves population advantage unresolved.
rejection_criterion.limitation: Eight founders is a bounded development screen chosen for comparability and runtime, not a power-qualified population confirmation. No unsupported practical-effect or equivalence margin.
rejection_criterion.interpretations: A pass supports the restricted forecasting lead on this panel. A failure rejects or narrows this particular forecast. Neither establishes or refutes broader RDT, causal correction, or repair benefit.
